item.title: Square White Background Sneaker

turns.text: Create one marketplace product photo of a white leather sneaker. Square image, plain white background, just the shoe.

item.tests: Delivers a text-generated marketplace image with the requested square framing and clean white background.

answer_sheet.Background and composition: Plain white background, just the shoe.

must_haves: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.
